corrections.old_text: ፰ ። ማቴ ፡ ፳፫ ፥ ፳፭ ። ይሁዳ ፡ ቍ ፡ ፲፩ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ፰ ። ማቴ ፡ ፳፫ ፥ ፴፭ ። ይሁዳ ፡ ቍ ፡ ፲፩ ።
corrections.reason: The printed Ethiopic numeral is ፴፭ (35), citing Matthew 23:35 (regarding the righteous blood of Abel), not ፳፭ (25).
The printed Ge'ez verb uses first-order የ (ወየዐብዮ), matching the citation on the very next line (የዐብዮ).
The parenthetical Ge'ez lemma clearly prints first-order የ in (የዐብዮ), matching lines 11 and 12.
